arms_status: structural endpoints; no probability weights or identified central split
direct_formula: I*tau*(1-d)*(1-q*(1-c)); d domestic share, c fraction of foreign tentative US tax offset, q foreign pre-tax replacement/source income
direct_q1_status: same pre-tax income arm; not generally equal worldwide after-tax return
equal_after_tax_formula: q=(1-tau)/(1-max(tau,f)); c=min(1,f/tau), with foreign tax rate f; proportional identical-base full-available-FTC arm

gilti_2024.inputs: T sum positive pro-rata tested incomes after foreign tax; G actual8992 inclusion after QBAI/tested losses/interest; F pro-rata tested foreign taxes
gilti_2024.warning: Only current inclusion tax for C corporation/962 electing individual; exclude distribution/residence taxes from automatic current correction; no measured CFC routing or QBAI values

human_capital.status: top-owner S corporation/partnership historical labor arm; not a normal-return fraction or ScheduleC estimate

state.ca_status: 2024 legal example only; not a national upper bound or additive new tax
